title: Rating
description: Displays a score as five stars on any scale, and collects scores with mouse or keyboard.

basic.title: Display
basic.description: Read-only ratings on a 10- or 5-point scale, with the value and the number of ratings.

interactive.title: Interactive
interactive.description: With onChange the rating becomes a slider: hover to preview, click the left or right half of a star, or use the arrow keys.

scale.title: Rating scale
scale.description: RatingScale rates several dimensions on one shared scale.

RatingProps.max: Highest score; always drawn on 5 stars
RatingProps.showValue: Shows the score after the stars
RatingProps.ratingCount: Number of ratings, shown after the score
RatingProps.readOnly: Forces display mode even when onChange is set
RatingProps.onKeyDown: Called before the built-in stepping; preventDefault() takes over a key
RatingProps.style: Inline styles of the root element

RatingScaleProps.dimensions: Dimensions to rate, one row each
RatingScaleProps.max: Highest score shared by every dimension
RatingScaleProps.onChange: Makes the rows interactive; receives the key and new score
RatingScaleProps.showValue: Shows the score at the end of each row

RatingDimension.key: Stable key, passed back to onChange
RatingDimension.label: Displayed label
RatingDimension.hint: Optional description (a string becomes the row tooltip)
